messages.subject: Two people who failed at this
messages.body:
As promised.

Corbin Achebe built scheduling software for equine practices in 2019, sold to four clinics, and shut it down eighteen months later. He is now running a wholesale supply business for the same market and will talk to anyone who asks. corbin.achebe@summit-vet-supply.com.

The second is someone I worked with at Millbridge. Tried to sell practice management to dental offices, could not get past the front desk, ran out of money. She has since joined a larger company doing something unrelated and would prefer I not share her name in writing, but I can introduce you over email if you would like to meet her.

Both were gracious about this when I asked, so do not wait.

Best,
Marguerite

messages.subject: Re: Two people who failed at this
messages.body:
This is great, thank you.

I'll reach out to Corbin this afternoon. And yes please to the second introduction, I would very much like to talk to her.

Best,
Priya

Connecting you both.

Priya, this is Lena Orosco. Lena, Priya Raghunathan, CTO at Thicket, practice management for veterinary clinics.

Lena spent two years trying to sell similar software into dental practices and has been generous enough to offer some time. I will leave you both to it.

Best,
Marguerite
